title: MLIPDiff: Guiding Denoising Diffusion Models for Structure-Based Drug Design via Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
abstract: arXiv:2610.33315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models have become a dominant approach to structure-based drug design. However, because they are trained primarily to fit reference structures, they often place ligands in physically implausible poses that clash with the protein. We introduce MLIPDiff, an inference-time guidance method that can be applied to pretrained diffusion models for ligand generation. The method uses physics-informed guidance from UMA (Universal Models for Atoms), a machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP). The guidance combines four weighted energy terms (protein-ligand interaction, ligand strain, steric clash, and pocket anchoring) and uses the original model checkpoint without retraining. On CrossDocked2020, MLIPDiff completely eliminates protein-ligand collisions while preserving the ligand's local geometry, improving bond-length distributions and physical plausibility relative to the base model. translated_title: MLIPDiff：通过机器学习原子间势引导去噪扩散模型用于基于结构的药物设计
translated_abstract: 扩散模型已成为基于结构的药物设计的主流方法。然而，由于这些模型主要以拟合参考结构为目标进行训练，它们常常将配体放置在与蛋白质发生碰撞的物理上不合理的位置。我们提出了MLIPDiff，这是一种可在推理阶段应用于预训练扩散模型的配体生成引导方法。该方法利用来自UMA（通用原子模型，Universal Models for Atoms）的物理信息引导，UMA是一种机器学习原子间势（MLIP）。该引导方法结合了四个加权能量项（蛋白质-配体相互作用、配体应变、空间位阻冲突和口袋锚定），并直接使用原始模型检查点，无需重新训练。在CrossDocked2020数据集上，MLIPDiff完全消除了蛋白质-配体碰撞，同时保持了配体的局部几何结构，相对于基础模型改善了键长分布和物理合理性。与NucleusDiff等模型相比……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: MLIPDiff利用机器学习原子间势（UMA）在推理阶段为预训练扩散模型提供物理信息引导，通过四个加权能量项在无需重新训练的情况下完全消除蛋白质-配体碰撞并提升生成配体的物理合理性。
en_tdlr: MLIPDiff leverages physics-informed guidance from a machine-learned interatomic potential (UMA) at inference time to steer pretrained diffusion models, using four weighted energy terms to completely eliminate protein-ligand collisions and improve physical plausibility without any retraining.
